candidates.original_title: Wnt activity defines colon cancer stem cells and is regulated by the microenvironment
candidates.description: CD133, the combination of CD29/CD24, and the combination of CD44/CD166 correlated with high Wnt activity (TOP-GFP[high] population)
candidates.citation_sentence: The original study stated that CD133, the combination of CD29/CD24, and the combination of CD44/CD166 were correlated with the TOP-GFP[high] population (Vermeulen et al., 2010).
candidates.notes: Authors explicitly state results varied in direction relative to the original study; some markers showed expected correlation, others did not. [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Wnt activity defines colon cancer stem cells and is regulated by the microenvironment
candidates.description: Clonogenic potential of TOP-GFP[high] fraction was greater compared to TOP-GFP[low] cells, with clonogenic potential of TOP-GFP[low] cells enhanced with MFCM or HGF treatment almost to the level of TOP-GFP[high] cells, which was blocked with PHA665752
candidates.citation_sentence: The original study reported the clonogenic potential of the TOP-GFP[high] fraction was greater compared to TOP-GFP[low] cells, with the clonogenic potential of TOP-GFP[low] cells enhanced with MFCM, or HGF, treatment, almost to the level of TOP-GFP[high] cells, which was blocked with PHA665752 (Vermeulen et al., 2010). PHA665752 was also reported to have no effect on the clonogenicity of TOP-GFP[whole] cells (Vermeulen et al., 2010).
candidates.notes: Results were in the same direction as the original study for most comparisons, except for treatment of TOP-GFP[whole] cells with PHA665752, and statistical significance varied among the three cultures tested. [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Wnt activity defines colon cancer stem cells and is regulated by the microenvironment
candidates.description: TOP-GFP[high] fraction was more effective in inducing tumors than TOP-GFP[low] fraction, and tumorigenicity was increased when TOP-GFP[low] cells were co-injected with MFCM
candidates.citation_sentence: The original study reported for each of the two clones tested (C100.B5 and C100.G7) the TOP-GFP[high] fraction was more effective in inducing tumors (C100.B5:~1 in every 37, 95% CI [92, 15]; C100.G7:~1 in every 961, 95% CI [2498, 369]) than the TOP-GFP[low] fraction (C100.B5:~1 in every 6939, 95% CI [18841, 2555]; C100.G7: frequency estimate unable to be determined) and that tumorigenicity was increased when TOP-GFP[low] cells were co-injected with MFCM (C100.B5:~1 in every 310, 95% CI [789, 122]; C100.G7:~1 in every 2352, 95% CI [5236, 1056]) (Vermeulen et al., 2010).
candidates.notes: Results were in the same direction as the original study for the comparison between TOP-GFP[low] with or without MFCM, but not for the comparison of TOP-GFP[low] and TOP-GFP[high], and not statistically significant where predicted. [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Wnt activity defines colon cancer stem cells and is regulated by the microenvironment
candidates.description: High Wnt activity, measured by the TOP-GFP reporter, is correlated with expression of CD133, the combination of CD29/CD24, and the combination of CD44/CD166 in colon cancer stem cell populations.
candidates.citation_sentence: The Registered Report for the paper by Vermeulen et al. (2010) described the experiments to be replicated (Figures 2F, 6D and 7E), and summarized the current evidence for these findings (Evans et al., 2015).
candidates.notes: Replication of Figure 2F. The paper states that results varied in direction relative to the original study. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Wnt activity defines colon cancer stem cells and is regulated by the microenvironment
candidates.description: Colon cancer cells with high TOP-GFP Wnt activity have greater clonogenic potential than TOP-GFP-low cells, while myofibroblast-conditioned medium or HGF increases clonogenicity of TOP-GFP-low cells and this increase is blocked by the c-Met inhibitor PHA-665752.
candidates.citation_sentence: The Registered Report for the paper by Vermeulen et al. (2010) described the experiments to be replicated (Figures 2F, 6D and 7E), and summarized the current evidence for these findings (Evans et al., 2015).
candidates.notes: Replication of Figure 6D. Results were generally in the same direction as the original, but the effect of PHA-665752 on the whole TOP-GFP population differed and statistical significance varied across cultures and comparisons. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Wnt activity defines colon cancer stem cells and is regulated by the microenvironment
candidates.description: Colon cancer cells with high TOP-GFP Wnt activity are more tumorigenic than TOP-GFP-low cells, and myofibroblast-conditioned medium increases the tumorigenicity of TOP-GFP-low cells.
candidates.citation_sentence: The Registered Report for the paper by Vermeulen et al. (2010) described the experiments to be replicated (Figures 2F, 6D and 7E), and summarized the current evidence for these findings (Evans et al., 2015).
candidates.notes: Replication of Figure 7E. The TOP-GFP-low versus TOP-GFP-high comparison did not reproduce the original direction, whereas the MFCM effect was in the same direction but not statistically significant. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]
